questionText:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Names) List-II (Associations)
(A) Piyadassi
(I) Script
(B) Kalinga
(II) Reporter
(C) Kharosthi

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Epigraphic terms: 'Piyadassi' (pleasant to behold) was the standard honorific title used by Emperor Asoka in his rock and pillar edicts (A-(III)). In Major Rock Edict VI, Ashoka commanded the 'pativedakas' (special reporters) to report public affairs to him at all times and places (D-(II)). Match: (A)-(III), (B)-(IV), (C)-(I), (D)-(II).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.

In Major Rock Edict VI, Ashoka commanded the 'pativedakas' (special reporters) to report public affairs to him at all times and places (D-(II)). Match: (A)-(III), (B)-(IV), (C)-(I), (D)-(II).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
